description.html: HabiStat Reptavite is a comprehensive vitamin and mineral supplement specially formulated for reptiles and amphibians. This product contains a wide range of essential vitamins, including vitamins A, D3, E and the complete B-complex, as well as mineral chelates that ensure optimal nutrient absorption. Reptavite is designed to complement your pets' diet and prevent the vitamin and mineral deficiencies that are common in captive animals.

It is used by dusting it over vegetables, fruit, meat or fish before feeding. The recommended dose is a quarter teaspoon at every fourth feeding, which allows gradual vitamin intake without the risk of overdose. It is especially suitable for iguanids, herbivorous lizards and tortoises, which need extra vitamins and minerals on a varied plant-based diet to stay healthy.

The mineral chelates in Reptavite are a special form of minerals bound to amino acids, which greatly improves their bioavailability compared to conventional mineral salts. This means your reptiles absorb a higher percentage of minerals from every meal. Regular use of this supplement contributes to stronger immunity, healthy skin and shedding, reproductive health and overall vitality in your animals.
